item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 05, 2026
item.description: It may be tough to stay on top of things today. Tension could spike with little warning, even with the Moon entering thoughtful Libra. This is due to Mercury squaring unpredictable Uranus at 7:13 am EST, putting diplomacy and change at odds with one another. We may wake seeking fairness, then face frustration that makes it hard to say anything nice. Potential conflict can be avoided by grounding innovative ideas with realistic goals. Today is meant for laying the foundation more than completing

item.title: Man, 19, arrested for targeted killing of Brooklyn dad in Bronx lobby
item.description: Thomas Padilla was just 17 when he gunned down 33-year-old Trevor Roberts inside the E. 174th St. building near Fteley Ave. in Soundview at 3:30 p.m., cops said.
